summary: Baidu, Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching its monthly return to the Hong Kong Stock Exchange for September 2026, covering movements in authorized share capital and issued shares. The filing confirms its voluntary conversion to dual primary listing on the HKEX Main Board became effective September 1, 2026. Issued Class A ordinary shares stood at 2,209,541,178, with no change over the month, and authorized capital remained at USD 43,520. The report is a routine equity-issuer monthly return, with no special-situation transaction terms; no board recommendation or advisor was disclosed.
